ValidationRule.description: Require Primary Contract Rejection Reason when Contract Status moves to Rejected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ($RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: SKP New Customer Setup' || $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: DP New Customer Setup' || $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: DMS' || $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: Tech Services New Customer Setup' || $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: New Customer Setup') && ISPICKVAL(Primary_Contract_Rejection_Reason__c,'') && ISPICKVAL(Contract_Status__c ,'Rejected') && (ISCHANGED(Contract_Status__c) || ISCHANGED(Primary_Contract_Rejection_Reason__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter the Primary Contract Rejection Reason when the Contract Status is Rejected.
